title: Adaptive sampling + exactly-once ingest for console metrics
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a deterministic, low-latency real-time ingest pipeline for console metrics that supports adaptive per-tenant sampling and end-to-end exactly-once semantics. The goal is to reduce cost from high-volume tenants while preserving signal for alerts and SLOs, and to guarantee no duplicates or loss during rolling upgrades, rebalances, and transient failures. This ticket implements the core pipeline components: an ingest proxy (lightweight HTTP -> Pulsar/TLS), a stateful streaming processor for sampling/dedup (Apache Flink), a compacted metrics write-topic, and a downstream aggregator that feeds the console observability store. The design prioritizes operational safety (safe rollout flags, canary sampling rates), clear schema evolution paths, and automated regression tests for correctness under failure injection.
acceptance_criteria: Stage pipeline deployed in staging cluster and accepting synthetic load up to 120k events/s
Exactly-once property validated via fault-injection test suite (producer retries, broker restarts, processor task failover) with zero observed duplicates in the compacted topic for 24h test run
Adaptive sampling control exists per-tenant via Console feature flag and defaults are conservative (no sampling until tenant > 1000 events/min)
End-to-end 99th percentile ingest-to-aggregation latency < 300ms under normal load; degradation path documented when bursting
Dashboards showing sampled vs raw event ratios, per-tenant event rates, and sampling budget burn rate are available
Runbook and rollback procedure documented and validated in tabletop exercise
updates: 2026-01-12: Initial design review w/ infra, observability, and product. Decided to use Pulsar for its compacted topic semantics and tiered storage plan; Flink chosen for stateful dedup and sampling logic.
2026-01-16: Prototype ingest-proxy implemented (http-to-pulsar) with TLS auth and per-tenant token mapping. Found 8% CPU overhead vs raw producer at 50k eps; acceptable.

2026-01-20: Added per-tenant sampling rules in design: static thresholds + dynamic cost-based throttles. PM requested conservative defaults to avoid losing important signals for recently onboarded tenants.

2026-01-25: Implemented dedup window using event id + Flink keyed state with TTL=10m. Edge-case note: out-of-order events from mobile clients require watermarking heuristics — default allowed skew 45s.

2026-01-28: Integration test failing intermittently under controller restart. Root cause: earlier attempt to implement idempotence only on producer side; moved idempotence enforcement into Flink sink with transactional writes to Pulsar. Implemented commit-phase timeout and retry.
2026-01-30: Performance bench: compacted topic re-ingest + aggregation achieves 110k eps sustained on staging cluster (3 brokers, 6 compute nodes). Need one more broker for headroom in production.
2026-02-01: PR #4578 opened. Code review feedback: add schema evolution checks and a consumer-side guard to reject unknown major versions. Working on addressing comments.
2026-02-02: Canary rollout plan approved by SRE and Product. Preparing feature flags and dashboard alerts for 5% -> 25% -> 100% tenant ramp.
implementation_notes: Ingest proxy: lightweight Go service, batching HTTP events into Pulsar producer with per-tenant routing. Exposes a /v1/events endpoint and returns ack with event_id and ingestion_timestamp.

Streaming processor: Flink job keyed by tenant_id, runs sampling policy (probabilistic + deterministic window-based retention for anomalies) and dedupes by event_id. Uses RocksDB for keyed state with incremental checkpointing to durable storage.
Write semantics: Use Pulsar transactions + compacted topic for final metrics; Flink sink uses two-phase commit to ensure exactly-once writes across failures.
Schema: Protobuf v3 messages registered in an internal schema registry. Compatibility: backward-compatible field additions only; any breaking change requires migration path and dual-emit period.
Sampling interface: expose API to Console for per-tenant overrides and a telemetry endpoint to view current effective sample rate per-tenant.
Backpressure and throttling: token-bucket per-tenant in ingest-proxy; when budget exhausted, proxy returns 429 with retry-after and increments a sampled drop counter for observability.
Reprocessing: support one-click reprocess from compacted topic to rebuild downstream aggregates for a tenant using compacted snapshots and a bounded window of raw events kept in cold storage.
Testing: add chaos tests for broker restarts, network partitions, and Flink task manager preemption. Add unit tests for probabilistic sampler and determinism tests using seeded RNG.
Operational primitives: feature flag for 'sampling-enabled' and an emergency 'drain-to-pass-through' switch that bypasses sampling and dedup for critical incident investigations.
risks_mitigations: Risk: Incorrect sampling could drop signals that are essential for alerts. Mitigation: Always retain full-fidelity events for tenants flagged as 'critical' and enforce a deterministic retention window for anomaly detection.

Risk: Exactly-once guarantees add complexity and can increase tail latency. Mitigation: measure trade-offs; provide a latency-first path that relaxes transactional guarantees for non-critical metrics.
Risk: Schema drift causing consumer crashes. Mitigation: strict schema registry checks at ingest + circuit breaker that quarantines malformed messages for manual inspection.
Risk: Pulsar broker capacity under-estimated. Mitigation: autoscaling policy for brokers and a pre-warm step before full production rollout; add smoke test that simulates tenant spike.
Risk: State store growth in Flink (per-tenant state). Mitigation: TTL and compaction for per-tenant keys; periodic compaction job to remove long-dead tenants.
qa_plan: Unit tests for sampling logic and deterministic RNG behavior
Integration tests with local Pulsar-Flink cluster in CI that run fault injection scenarios
End-to-end staging load test with synthetic tenants including mix of bursty and steady producers
Canary rollout with 10 tenants for 48 hours while monitoring key metrics and alert thresholds before wider ramp
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Deploy ingest-proxy + Flink job to staging. Validate correctness and perf.
Phase 1 (Canary): Enable sampling for 5% of tenants (lowest-traffic group) for 24-48 hours. Monitor dashboards and errors.
Phase 2 (Gradual): Ramp 5% -> 25% -> 100% over multiple days with opt-out control for tenants.
Emergency rollback: Flip feature flag 'drain-to-pass-through' to bypass sampling/dedup, or revert to previous Flink job snapshot if data corruption is suspected.
Post-rollout: 7-day observation window with prioritized alerts and a postmortem checklist
observability: Metrics: per-tenant incoming EPS, sampled EPS, dropped-by-budget, dedup-rate, Flink checkpoint duration, Pulsar write latencies
Traces: distributed traces from producer -> proxy -> Flink -> sink with tracing headers preserved
Dashboards: staging + prod dashboards created; alerts for sampling-error-rate > 0.1% and dedup anomalies
Audit logs: every sampling-rule change recorded with user and timestamp; retained for 90 days
